summary.text: Catherine Blakespear was elected in 2022 as the state senator for California's 38th District, which covers northern San Diego County and southern Orange County.

paragraphs.text: She previously served eight years in local government, six as mayor of Encinitas and two on the Encinitas City Council.
According to her Senate website, she is a lawyer and former journalist and lives in Encinitas. She chairs the Senate Environmental Quality Committee.
